item.title: AI Engineering Architecture: Building It Up Step by Step
item.description:
Simple definition#

Most AI applications converge on the same architecture, but no team should build it all on day one. This article grows it one component at a time, each added only when a concrete need appears: context, guardrails, routing, caching, actions — and the observability that makes all of it operable.

item.title: Claude Code for Teams and Organisations
item.description:
Simple definition#

For a team, Claude Code configuration has three owners. The repository carries shared conventions, permissions, hooks, skills, agents and MCP servers, committed like any other code. Each developer keeps personal preferences in local and user files. The organisation sets policy through managed settings that no one else can override, and watches usage and spend through analytics and telemetry.
